title: Hollywood exit and return to lead a band at the Casino Royal
summary: He played the Casino dance hall with Spud Murphy and made a film in Hollywood, then left because of war fears.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: He used to come at the famous door and sit in, yeah. Oh, what about Spud Murphy? Did you ever know him? Yeah, I was Spud Murphy at the dance hall at the casino.
Hollywood, yeah. Hollywood, yeah. That was the same year I made Red of Montero, Red Bull. Yeah, it was in choreography.
And did you, uh, what happened when you left Hollywood?
Well, uh, I'll tell you what happened. World War II, you know? Mm-hmm. And they said they were going to bomb the Boulder Dam and all that stuff and everybody started moving on Hollywood, see?
So I came back home. When I came back home, I went to wake at the Casino Royal. I had a band there for, for a couple years.
Yeah, I went there. And then... And where?
